name: en-instruction-following
description: Verifiable format constraints in the IFEval style, in en. Every instruction is checked by counting or matching, never by judging quality. Constraints accumulate, so a later turn also tests whether earlier ones are still honoured.

turns.say: Answer in exactly five words: what is the capital of France?
Describe the Eiffel Tower in at most 20 words, and do not use the words "tall" or "iron".
List exactly three European capitals, one per line, nothing else.
Reply using only lowercase letters: name the river running through Paris.
Reply with a single line in exactly this shape: CITY=<name> COUNTRY=<name>, filled in for the capital you named first.
How many words did I ask for in my very first question? Reply with the number only.
